Dates, renewals and support deadlines. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD on the panel clock. Changes need Full access.

Reading needs **Read only** and changes need **Full**, unless an endpoint says otherwise. [How to read this page](/docs/integrations/api-reference/#how-to-read-a-group-page).

### `GET /api/reminders`

List reminders and their current state.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?siteId=&serverId=`
- **Returns:** `{items: ReminderDto[]}`

### `GET /api/reminders/summary`

Count flagged reminders.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Returns:** `{count, tone, today, timezone}`

### `GET /api/reminders/options`

List suggestions, links and confirmed recipients.

- **Level:** Read only

### `GET /api/reminders/:id`

Read a reminder.

- **Level:** Read only

### `POST /api/reminders`

Create a reminder.

- **Level:** Full
- **Input:** `{title, dueDate: "YYYY-MM-DD", kind?: "once"|"recurring"|"domain"|"cloudflare"|"php"|"os", note?, warningDays?: [0], every?: 1, unit?: "days"|"weeks"|"months"|"years", siteId?, serverId?, email?: false, recipientUserId?: null (alert address), domain?, automatic?: false, subject?: from suggestions}`

### `PATCH /api/reminders/:id`

Edit a reminder.

- **Level:** Full
- **Input:** `Any create fields`

### `DELETE /api/reminders/:id`

Delete a reminder.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive

### `POST /api/reminders/:id/done`

Complete, advance or await renewal confirmation.

- **Level:** Full

### `POST /api/reminders/:id/reopen`

Reopen a completed reminder.

- **Level:** Full

### `POST /api/reminders/:id/snooze`

Snooze until a date or clear snooze.

- **Level:** Full
- **Input:** `{until: "YYYY-MM-DD"|null}`

### `POST /api/reminders/refresh`

Refresh token and server facts, subject to the daily cache.

- **Level:** Full

### `POST /api/reminders/calendar`

Create or replace the secret calendar link.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Not over MCP
- **Returns:** `{path} (shown once)`

### `DELETE /api/reminders/calendar`

Revoke the calendar link.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive · Not over MCP
